name: Schneider ATV12HU22M2 · 2.2 kW · 230 V
spec: Single-phase 200-240 V input; 10 A continuous output at 4 kHz switching frequency; 0.5-400 Hz fundamental output. Match 220 V spindle nameplate voltage, rated current, base frequency and cable/EMC requirements. No safety-rated STO assumed.

name: Delta DVP14SS211T · transistor PLC
spec: 24 VDC PLC; 8 DI and 6 transistor DO. Add I/O expansion after completing the machine I/O schedule; this PLC is not a safety controller.

name: STEPPERONLINE CL57T V3 · closed-loop driver
spec: V3.0 enclosure only; 24-48 VDC. Verify delivered revision and encoder compatibility before ordering.

name: MEAN WELL LRS-150-24 · 24 V / 6.5 A
spec: 156 W, 24 VDC, 6.5 A. Set input selector to 230 V; verify total simultaneous solenoid and motor load.

name: Pilz PNOZ X3 · 774310 · 24 V
spec: 24 VAC/DC safety relay; three N/O safety outputs. Requires a designed and validated safety circuit; relay presence alone does not establish a performance level.

name: Digital Dream DDCS v4.1 · 4-axis motion controller
spec: 24 V system and isolated I/O supplies; 18 inputs, three 50 mA sinking outputs and 0–10 V spindle command. X feed / Z saw; process PLC handles stock identity and valves. Panel cutout requires checking the delivered unit: manual text and drawing conflict.

name: Schneider XB5AS8444 · D40 emergency stop · 2 NC
spec: D22 panel mounting; D40 latching red mushroom, twist release, two NC contacts. Contact body contours are simplified. Connect both channels to the independent safety circuit; reset must not restart motion.

name: Digital Dream DDCS v3.1 · 4-axis controller
spec: 24 V controller; pulse/direction for up to four axes and 0-10 V spindle command. Published rear body 175 x 110 mm; fascia 191 x 128 mm. Manual text and drawing disagree on depth and panel cutout: measure supplied unit before machining the panel.

name: MEAN WELL LRS-350-48 · 48 V / 7.3 A
spec: 350.4 W, 48 VDC, 7.3 A; 215 x 115 x 30 mm case. 230 V input selector. Check regenerated motor voltage, simultaneous load, ambient derating and protective bonding. Terminal and mounting contours remain reference geometry.

name: MEAN WELL LRS-350-36 · 36 V / 9.7 A
spec: 349.2 W, 36 VDC, 9.7 A; 215 x 115 x 30 mm case. 230 V input selector. Selected below the CL57T 48 V maximum to reserve voltage headroom; measure regeneration and total simultaneous load.

name: Huanyang 4 kW / 220 V - G-Penny supplier execution
spec: Source-listed 220 V execution: 1- or 3-phase 220 V input, 3-phase 220 V output, rated output 17 A, fundamental frequency 0-400 Hz. 4 kW class for a 3 kW spindle. Exact manufacturer order code is unpublished; verify delivered execution, current availability, motor winding/current and VFD parameters before release. No STO or functional safety claim.
